title: Difference of Squares
prompt:
In this project directory, implement a Python module named difference_of_squares.py with two functions:
  - square_of_sum(n: int) -> int : returns the square of the sum of the first n positive integers (1..n).
  - sum_of_squares(n: int) -> int : returns the sum of the squares of the first n positive integers (1..n).
There is already a hidden reference test suite at tests/test_difference_of_squares.py -- do NOT modify it. Your Testing phase should run `pytest tests -q` (in addition to any tests you write yourself) and every test must pass. Also add a short README.md explaining the two functions.
